evidence_files.prompt-r1.txt: Create one high-resolution horizontal 16:9 source image for a commercial location-art library. Photorealistic documentary realism, original AI-generated artistic interpretation, not a photograph. Scene: Toledo old town and Alcazar from the real public Mirador del Valle roadside viewpoint south of the Tagus, camera at plausible eye level looking northwest across the river gorge. Reproduce the recognizable skyline hierarchy and geography: dense ochre and terracotta-roofed historic city on the hill; the large square, four-cornered Alcazar mass dominant on the right/east high point; the Gothic Cathedral tower and spire left of the Alcazar nearer the center; stone walls and the Tagus curving below in the foreground gorge. Do not turn the Alcazar into a fantasy castle and do not enlarge the Cathedral. Include the roadside stone viewpoint edge only subtly, with no close identifiable people. Keep the full skyline and generous sky margin; compose so a later centered 4:5 crop retains both Alcazar and Cathedral. Actual scenario: 23 September 2026 at 20:31 Europe/Madrid, DUSK twilight, 20 minutes after local sunset 20:11; approximate sun elevation -4.31 degrees, azimuth 273.81 west. Open-Meteo model: 30.7 C, partly cloudy code 2, 75 percent cloud, no precipitation, light wind; model data, not an on-site observation. Show a mostly clouded blue-grey early twilight sky with only a muted warm western break, city and gorge in soft ambient shadow. Do not invent stars, moon, wetness, floodlighting, illuminated monuments, fireworks, flags, cranes, logos, legible text, or fantasy towers. No HDR, no oversaturated sunset, no aerial/drone view. Tripod-stable 50mm-equivalent panorama with natural proportions, neutral color and realistic atmospheric depth. No captions or watermark.
